founded: {0} has been founded. Your colony claim now protects the land around the Town Hall.
not-in-colony: You are not inside a colony.
no-colony: You do not own a colony. Place a Town Hall first.
found-error-overlapsclaim: This spot is too close to another land claim.
invited: {0} invited you to join {1}. Type /colony join to accept.
no-invite: You have no pending colony invite.
not-member: You are not a member of a colony here.
owner-cannot-leave: The owner cannot leave. Break the Town Hall to disband the colony.
supplycamp-outside: Build the supply camp inside a colony you belong to.
supplycamp-exists: This colony already has a supply camp.
supplycamp-tomorrow: The camp has nothing more today. Come back tomorrow.
supplycamp-exhausted: The supply camp has run dry. Your colony must provide for itself now.
supplycamp-delivered: You collect the day's supplies. Deliveries left: {0}.
no-citizens: This colony has no settlers yet.
visitor-readonly: You are visiting. Only officers and the owner can change things here.
invite-hint: To add a player, stand in your colony and type /colony invite <name>. They accept with /colony join.
denied-officer: Only officers and the owner can do that.
denied-owner: Only the colony owner can do that.
owner-fixed: The owner's role cannot be changed.
bad-member: That player is not a member of this colony.
marker-outside: This must be placed inside a colony you are a member of.
warehouse-exists: This colony already has a warehouse. Break the old marker first.
warehouse-placed: Warehouse set up. Every chest within {0} blocks of this marker is now warehouse storage.
warehouse-summary: Warehouse: {0} chests, {1} items stored, {2} of {3} slots free.
dropoff-help: Couriers empty any chest touching this marker into the warehouse.
overview-no-warehouse: No warehouse yet. Place a Warehouse marker so couriers can work.
request-usage: Look at a chest, then type /colony request <item code> <amount>, for example /colony request game:plank-* 16
request-not-container: Look at a chest inside the colony first.
request-created: Request #{0}: {1} x {2}. A courier will bring it from the warehouse.
build-hint: The Builder's Hut has its own storage (sneak + right-click it, or use Storage in its window). The builder takes materials and tools from it, and couriers fill it from the warehouse. Chests next to the hut add more room.
buildstatus-waiting-materials: waiting for couriers to bring materials
buildstatus-no-hut-chest: the Builder's Hut needs a chest next to it
buildstatus-no-builder-hut: no Builder's Hut for the builder to work from
buildstatus-unreachable: builder can't reach the next block
build-already: That building is already being built.
build-no-blueprint: There is no blueprint for the next level of that building.
rotate-built: A building can only be turned before it is built.
hut-placed: {0} placed. Right-click it to order level 1. Sneak + right-click opens its storage.
blueprints-reloaded: Blueprints reloaded. Your own blueprints go in {0}
import-done: Converted {0} into {1} level {2} ({3} blocks). Open the Town Hall's Buildings tab to build it.
import-all-matched: Every block had a Vintage Story match.
buildstatus-needs-tool-shovel: needs a shovel (put one in the hut chest or the warehouse)
buildstatus-needs-tool-axe: needs an axe (put one in the hut chest or the warehouse)
buildstatus-needs-tool-pickaxe: needs a pickaxe (put one in the hut chest or the warehouse)
hut-no-builder: No builder works from this hut yet. Give a settler the Builder job in the Town Hall.
hut-no-orders: No work orders. Order a building from its own hut (or the Town Hall upgrade from the Town Hall).
items-nothing: {0} has no work order right now.
items-none: Nothing more is needed. The builder has everything.
townhall-builder-hint: Order other buildings by right-clicking their hut block. The Builder's Hut shows all work orders and the items its builder needs.
any-type: Use any wood or stone type
any-type-on: Builders may use any wood or stone type.
any-type-off: Builders use exactly the wood and stone the blueprint asks for.
any-type-hint: When on, pine logs can stand in for oak logs, andesite for granite, and so on. The block is built in the type the builder brings.
items-any-binding: Roof binding: flax fibers, cattail tops, papyrus tops or wild vines
bag-given: {0} now wears the bag and has {1} inventory slots.
bag-taken: You took a bag back from {0}. They now have {1} inventory slots.
activity-builder-stash: Putting things away at the hut
citizen-gear-hint: Clothing and armor slots, for when settlers can wear things.
citizen-bag-hint: Right-click a settler while holding a bag to give it to them. Sneak and right-click with an empty hand to take one back.
hut-placed-worker: {0} placed. Put the job's tool in its storage (sneak + right-click), then give a settler the {1} job in the Town Hall.
hut-no-worker: Nobody works here yet. Give a settler the {0} job in the Town Hall.
hut-fields: Fields looked after: {0} (the colony has {1} Field markers)
hint-forester: Put an axe in the hut's storage. The forester fells trees within {0} blocks of the hut (change this on the Work area tab) and replants them with tree seeds. Logs, sticks and seeds go into the hut's storage and couriers take them to the warehouse. Chests next to the hut add more room.
hint-farmer: Put a hoe and some seeds in the hut's storage, and place Field markers. The farmer tills, sows, weeds, waters and harvests around each marker, and picks ripe berry bushes and fruit trees within {0} blocks of the hut (change this on the Work area tab). A watering can and fertilizer in the hut's storage get used too. The harvest goes into the hut's storage and couriers take it to the warehouse. Chests next to the hut add more room.
workstatus-no-hut-chest: the hut has no storage (break and place it again)
workstatus-hut-chest-full: the hut storage is full (a courier will empty it, or put a chest next to the hut for more room)
workstatus-needs-tool-axe: needs an axe (put one in the hut storage or the warehouse)
workstatus-needs-tool-hoe: needs a hoe (put one in the hut storage or the warehouse)
workstatus-searching: searching the work area for trees
workstatus-no-trees: no trees left in reach, waiting for saplings to grow
workstatus-no-fields: no fields. Place a Field marker in the colony.
workstatus-needs-seeds: needs seeds (put some in the hut storage or the warehouse)
workstatus-growing: waiting for the crops to grow
workstatus-unreachable: can't reach its next spot, trying another
field-placed: Field marked out: the {0} by {0} square around this marker is now farmland for your farmers. Right-click it with seeds to choose the crop.
field-crop-set: This field will be sown with {0}.
field-crop-any: This field will be sown with whatever seeds the farmer has.
field-info: Field. Crop: {0}. Farmer: {1}. Right-click with seeds to choose the crop; sneak and right-click with an empty hand to allow any.
activity-worker-deposit: Taking the harvest to the hut
workarea-range-hint-forester: The forester fells the trees nearest the hut first and works outward. Land far from every player is searched a little at a time, and only land someone has already explored.
workarea-range-hint-farmer: This is how far the farmer goes for berries and fruit. Fields are wherever you place Field markers. Berries further than 32 blocks out are picked when the fields have nothing to do.
workarea-escort-hint: Turn this on and a guard follows the worker everywhere and fights monsters near it.
workarea-escort-none: No free guard yet (the colony has {0}). Give a settler the Guard job in the Town Hall, or make sure this hut has a worker.
workarea-berries-hint: The farmer picks ripe berry bushes and fruit trees within the range above.
bad-radius: That range is not one of the choices.
activity-guard-weapon: Fetching a weapon from the warehouse
activity-guard-post: Keeping watch at the Town Hall
itemdesc-builderswand: Right-click the ground to pick a building and see where it would stand, then Accept to place its block from your inventory. Right-click a hut to move it before it is built.
wand-not-building: Right-click a hut, the Town Hall or the Warehouse of your colony with the Builder's Wand.
placement-shown: The outline shows level {0}, the biggest this building gets. {1} of its {2} blocks are in the way (red) and the builder will clear them.
placement-no-blueprint: There is no blueprint for this building yet, so there is nothing to show.
placement-fixed: Building has started, so it can no longer be turned or moved.
placement-hint: Forward, back, left and right go the way you are looking. Press Esc to close this window and walk around the outline; right-click with the Builder's Wand (on a block or in the air) to come back. Build here orders it; Not here gives the hut back.
placement-ordered: {0} ordered. A builder will start on it.
placement-built: Building has started there, so it can no longer be turned, moved or taken back.
placement-keep: The Town Hall and the Warehouse cannot be taken back this way.
use-wand: Use the Builder's Wand to place this: right-click the ground with it and pick the building. Keep this block in your inventory.
wand-aim-ground: Right-click the ground where you want to build.
wand-choose-hint: Pick a building to see its outline where you clicked. Placing it uses one of its blocks from your inventory.
wand-style-note-devsbuilds: Dev's Builds holds the developer's own designs. They are on the way.
wand-tab-empty: Nothing here yet. More buildings are on the way.
wand-tab-note-fundamentals: Settlers sleep in any bed inside the colony. Houses will come here later.
wand-tab-note-infrastructure: Drop-offs and the Supply Camp are placed by hand, like any other block.
wand-tab-note-military: Guards need no building yet: give any settler the Guard job in the Town Hall.
wand-have: You have {0} {1} block(s); Accept uses one.
wand-need-block: You need a {0} block in your inventory to place it.
wand-unknown: That building cannot be placed with the wand.
wand-spot-taken: Something is in the way where the building's block goes (the yellow block).
placement-hint-planned: Forward, back, left and right go the way you are looking. Press Esc and walk around the outline; right-click with the wand (on a block or in the air) to come back. Accept puts the building's block down at the yellow spot.
hint-potter: Put clay in the hut's storage, and dry grass, sticks and firewood for the kiln (couriers bring them from the warehouse too). The potter shapes clay on a clay forming block next to the hut, digs a pit kiln nearby and fires what it made there, just as you would. The Pottery tab says what to keep in stock. Fired pottery goes into the hut's storage and couriers take it to the warehouse.
hut-placed-potter: {0} placed. Give a settler the Potter job in the Town Hall, and put clay in the hut's storage (sneak + right-click).
pottery-hint: The potter makes pieces until the colony has as many as it keeps in stock, counting the warehouse, this hut and the kiln. A crucible and ingot molds are what it takes to smelt copper.
pottery-none: The game has no clay forming recipes that fire in a pit kiln.
kiln-fired: Kiln: fired, waiting to be emptied
workstatus-needs-clay: needs clay (put some in the hut storage or the warehouse)
workstatus-needs-kiln-fuel: needs fuel for the kiln: dry grass, sticks and firewood (put them in the hut storage or the warehouse)
workstatus-kiln-emptying: taking fired pottery out of the kiln
workstatus-no-kiln-spot: can't find ground for a pit kiln near the hut (it needs soil, gravel or sand with solid, non-flammable ground around it)
workstatus-no-form-spot: can't find a free spot with floor near the hut to shape clay
workstatus-pottery-stocked: everything is in stock (change it on the Pottery tab)
hut-placed-tavern: {0} placed. Right-click it to order level 1. Once it is built, people looking for work stop by every day: hire them on its Recruits tab.
recruits-have: You have {0} rusty gears (counting the Tavern's storage).
recruits-hint: New people stop by every morning. Hiring one takes the gears from your inventory first, then from the Tavern's storage, and they step out of the Tavern.
recruits-none: Nobody else is looking for work today. Come back tomorrow.
recruit-gone: That person has already left the Tavern.
recruit-cant-afford: You do not have enough rusty gears for that.
recruit-failed: Something went wrong spawning the settler; see the server log.
recruit-hired: {0} has joined {1}, hired at the Tavern by {2}.
tavern-open: The Tavern is open: see the Recruits tab for who is looking for work today.
tavern-closed: Build level 1 of the Tavern and people looking for work start stopping by.
tavern-wanderers: With the Tavern built, wanderers come asking to join about every {0} days.
tavern-no-wanderers: Wanderers are turned off in the server config.
tavern-beds: Free beds: {0}. Wanderers only come while there is a free bed.
visitor-no-job: Welcome this wanderer into the colony first, then give them a job.
visitor-arrived: A wanderer named {0} is walking to the Town Hall of {1} and asks to join. Open the Town Hall's Settlers tab to welcome them or turn them away.
visitor-left: {0} waited at {1} but nobody answered, and moved on.
visitor-welcomed: {0} is now a settler of {1}. Give them a job in the Town Hall.
visitor-turned-away: {0} was turned away from {1} and leaves.
overview-wanderers-bed: Wanderers: about every {0} days while there is a free bed (free beds: {1})
overview-visitors: {0} wanderer(s) waiting on the Settlers tab
permadeath-on-hint: A settler who is killed is gone for good. Hire new ones at the Tavern or welcome wanderers.
permadeath-off-hint: A settler who is killed is only knocked out, and comes back to the Town Hall after a day.
denied-member: Only colony members can do that.
activity-visitor-walking: Walking to the Town Hall to ask to join
activity-visitor-waiting: Waiting to hear if they may stay
wanderer-no-spot: No wanderer could find a way in: no loaded dry ground near the colony border.
hut-placed-cook: {0} placed. Right-click it to order level 1 (it comes with a fire pit), give a settler the Cook job in the Town Hall, and put raw meat, fish or dough and firewood in the hut's storage (sneak + right-click).
hint-cook: Put raw food (meat, fish, bread dough and anything else the game cooks in a fire pit) and firewood in the hut's storage; couriers bring them from the warehouse too. The cook cooks it in the fire pit next to the hut, just as you would, and keeps the cooked food in the hut's storage, where hungry settlers come to eat. The Kitchen tab says how much of each food to keep.
kitchen-hint: The cook cooks until the colony has this much of each food ready (servings, for pot meals), counting the warehouse and this hut. Pot meals need an empty cooking pot in the hut storage or warehouse.
kitchen-none: The game has no raw foods that cook in a fire pit.
firepit-none: No fire pit within {0} blocks of the hut. Build the hut (its blueprint has one) or place a fire pit nearby.
firepit-waiting: Fire pit: {0} waiting for the fire to be lit
workstatus-no-firepit: no fire pit near the hut
workstatus-firepit-emptying: taking cooked food out of the fire pit
workstatus-firepit-busy: the fire pit has something in it that the cook does not know how to cook; take it out
workstatus-fetching-food: fetching raw food from the hut
workstatus-waiting-food: waiting for a courier to bring raw food from the warehouse
workstatus-needs-raw-food: needs raw food to cook (put meat, fish or dough in the hut storage or the warehouse)
workstatus-kitchen-stocked: everything is in stock (change it on the Kitchen tab)
workstatus-needs-firewood: needs firewood (put some in the hut storage or the warehouse)
activity-cook-empty: Taking cooked food off the fire
workstatus-waiting-pot: waiting for a courier to bring a cooking pot
pathdebug-on: Path debug on: sparks over stuck settlers, Willpower and ladder lines in the server log.
